application.description: Approved application-only shell extension for School Admin, Teacher, and Parent; operational overview for School Admin. Existing authentication fields remain unchanged.
application.brand: Official colored wordmark/symbol in Light and Mist; official white wordmark/symbol in Midnight and Dark. Symbols replace wordmarks only in collapsed navigation; never mirror assets.
application.typography: Existing self-hosted Madrasio Inter and Madrasio Arabic; Arabic family first in RTL. Application type does not revise authentication roles.

breakpoints.name: application-mobile-max
breakpoints.purpose: Compact navbar, two-column metrics with final two full-width cards, stacked communication.

breakpoints.name: application-sidebar-min
breakpoints.purpose: Desktop navigation; smaller screens use the modal drawer.

breakpoints.name: application-single-operations-max
breakpoints.purpose: Stack timetable and finance; place metric icons above values.

application.motion: Honor reduced motion by removing application animations/transitions. Existing drawer focus trap, Escape dismissal, focus restoration, inert background and scroll lock remain required.
application.profile: Base UI Popover with DirectionProvider; school/current academic year, membership school switcher, existing language/theme preferences and logout. Portaled popup retains application scope. School Admin with platform authority retains Platform Schools in the profile, preserving thirteen sidebar destinations; other roles retain platform navigation.

rules.name: The Application Scope Rule
rules.body: Application overrides live under .madrasio-workspace, including the portaled profile popup. Do not promote these overrides into global or authentication tokens.

rules.name: The Recording Completeness Rule
rules.body: Pending attendance means incomplete records for the effective eligible roster of a started published lesson. It never represents absence. Future lessons, unavailable status, and no-roster cases remain distinct.

rules.name: The Verified Context Rule
rules.body: Overview reads require School Admin and existing permissions, and use server-verified school context. The context-only academic-year read is available to authorized school roles. Both return private, no-store responses.

verification.method: Source inspection and manual screenshot comparison; no numeric comp score or unavailable detector/engine/build-gate closure claimed.
verification.fixtureReport: test-results/app-dashboard/final-results.json: 24 locale/device/theme cases and 24 responsive checks; no reported failures/errors; role/data-state/language/thirteen-destination/mocked school-switch/logout scenarios. Bounded fixture evidence, not live-school or generated-gate proof.
verification.fixtureCoherence: 71 enrolled, four classes, three teachers; three lessons with one recorded, one pending and one upcoming. Verification fixture only, never a product total.
verification.initialCaptureLimit: initial-* predates the final currency-layout correction and coherent synthetic fixture. Fixture totals are not product rules or live-school data.
verification.unrepairedDrift: Pre-existing authentication documentation drift is outside this approved extension.

display.purpose: 800 static face; approved compact Login and expanded Recovery/Password responsive sizes remain surface-specific.

label.purpose: Visible form and preference labels; Arabic uses 13px.

shadows.name: auth-card
shadows.purpose: Desktop form card; removed on mobile.

narrative.overview: Authentication-scoped implementation of the supplied Madrasio Authentication UI Showcase. Official identity assets, orange action emphasis, four background identities, and multilingual operation guide this surface. Application chrome is outside this redesign.
keyCharacteristics: English, French, and Arabic with RTL support

rules.name: The Surface Scope Rule
rules.body: Keep authentication tokens scoped to authentication; theme compatibility does not authorize restyling application chrome.

dos: Do use official wordmark-colored in Light/Mist and wordmark-white in Midnight/Dark for authentication, without overlays.
Do preserve System theme compatibility and existing authentication behavior.
donts: Don't generalize login composition into a global application layout.
